[[File:Dretcher.png|thumb|right|250px|Dretcher, an Anomid identity slicer]]
'''Identity slicers''' were forgers who specialized in altering a person's identity. Skilled identity slicers, such as [[Dalan Reid]], could alter one's genetic code and create [[Cloning/Legends|replicas]] of a person. Such expertise took years to master.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=codex|Identity Slicers}}</ref> The [[Anomid/Legends|Anomid]] [[Dretcher]] was an identity slicer who provided [[Gender/Legends|his]] services to the [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]] [[Gault Rennow]].<ref name="KOTFE">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=13}}</ref>
